title: eryngium subinerme
intro: Eryngium subinerme, commonly known as the silver sea holly, is a plant species in the carrot family that is native to New Zealand. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of digestive issues, fever reduction, and relief from respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Eryngium subinerme are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes and alkaloids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health, and its use should be approached with caution due to potential side effects and interactions with other medications.
